description:
An open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions — install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM.

Goose is an open source, extensible general-purpose AI agent that runs locally. It automates engineering tasks by installing, executing, editing, and testing with any LLM.
The CLI works with 15+ providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, OpenRouter, Azure, and Bedrock, and extends through 70+ MCP (Model Context Protocol) extensions. Goose can act as an Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agent for editors such as Zed and JetBrains IDEs, and supports ACP agents as providers.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Drop tool approval state from imported sessions to prevent automatic tool execution on session load
- Import sessions with local extensions and goose mode, dropping recipe retry, recipe values, container and provider session IDs
- Remove recipe template re-rendering on session load and fork
- Remove dotenv from desktop app to prevent unintended environment variable loading
🔧 Improvements
- Run release follow-up workflows only for pushes to this repository
- Keep rejected release runs out of the release-notes and pages concurrency groups
